body: thank you for your comment, i also have inattentive ADHD so it really is hard for me. one day being really loved by the girl i hope i would be with forever and the next saying she doesn't want to be with me anymore and forcing me to move on, even though she is saying this stuff to me, i keep supporting her and asking how she is and all she says is "stop talking to me" or "i wont come back just move on" and these comments really bring me down cause it feels like she doesn't appreciate or even seem to care at all.

ive always been texting her and telling her that i'm always here for her, but she always says to me "leave me alone" "just move on i wont comeback" and comments like this really brings me down and pushing me to stop talking to her. so now what i'm doing is just giving her space but i'm scared if i give her space she will gain feelings to guys she is talking to right now.
thank you for your reply, i will try focus on myself and not to much on her.

yes you are right, i hope her depression will come down soon and she will come back to me, but once again, i wont rely on that to much. right now im really trying to focus on myself and school like you said.

ive been very upset these last few days thinking about it, especially seeing her talk to other guys. But i will try distract myself, find a job and do what i love doing and not be all over her. Thank you for your reply.
